data.notes: June 2026 is unusually festival-heavy around Seoul, with K-pop arena runs overlapping EDM, hip-hop, and picnic-style outdoor festivals.

events.title: 2026 Weverse Con Festival
events.venueName: Olympic Park, KSPO Dome & 88 Lawn Field
events.summary: HYBE/Weverse’s annual K-pop festival returns to Olympic Park over two days, with official programming split between Weverse Park and Weverse Con stages.

events.title: 2026 World DJ Festival
events.summary: Korea’s long-running EDM festival is confirmed for two days at Seoul Land, with official ticketing listing 14:00–22:00 running hours and 19+ admission.

events.title: RAPBEAT 2026
events.summary: RAPBEAT 2026 is confirmed for two days at Oil Tank Culture Park in Mapo-gu, returning as a large-scale urban music festival centered on hip-hop and related Korean pop scenes.

events.title: 2026 Seoul Park Music Festival
events.venueName: Olympic Park 88 Lawn Field & Ticketlink Live Arena
events.summary: Seoul Park Music Festival is confirmed at Olympic Park’s 88 Lawn Field and Ticketlink Live Arena for a two-day early-summer picnic-and-music format.

events.title: 2026-27 BABYMONSTER World Tour [춤 (CHOOM)] in Seoul
events.summary: BABYMONSTER starts the CHOOM world tour with three Seoul shows at Jamsil Indoor Stadium on June 26, 27, and 28.

events.title: TREASURE THE STAGE 2026 in Seoul
events.summary: TREASURE’s official Weverse notice confirms three Seoul concerts at Korea University Hwajeong Tiger Dome on June 19, 20, and 21.

events.title: 2026 TWS Tour '24/7:FOR:YOU' in Seoul
events.summary: PLEDIS and HYBE confirm TWS’s Seoul tour dates at KSPO Dome on June 27 and 28, with both in-person and online live-streaming planned.

events.title: FLUIDICA: SEOUL PRIDE RAVE
events.summary: Queer underground rave FLUIDICA returns for a Seoul Pride afterparty at Eagle Seoul, combining hard/driving techno with drag, voguing, performance and dance until sunrise.

events.title: 2026 XIA 6th Asia Tour Concert 'GRAVITY' in Seoul
events.summary: Kim Junsu (XIA) opens his GRAVITY Asia tour with three KSPO Dome performances on June 12, 13, and 14.

events.title: Oslated 10 years night with Adhémar
events.summary: Jeju-rooted label Oslated marks its 10th anniversary in Seoul as part of the Fête de la Musique Korea program, headlined by Paris-based Adhémar with Hii., Hogun and ccb.

events.title: 2026 AND2BLE Show Concert: Welcome to Qurious
events.summary: AND2BLE’s official Weverse schedule lists the Seoul opening run of Welcome to Qurious at Jamsil Indoor Stadium from June 19 to 21.

events.title: Cakeshop presents: KAVARI (XL rec / UK)
events.summary: Cakeshop hosts KAVARI’s Seoul debut, a bass/IDM-leaning experimental electronic night from the XL-linked UK artist, running 22:00–05:00.

events.title: Planet Turbo presents: Oneman
events.summary: Planet Turbo hosts UK selector Oneman at intimate Itaewon room Pistil, with a UK garage/funky/grime/house-leaning lineup including Hyejin, Juuno, Haney Lee and Shins.

events.title: Carve Out Records with XDB (Metrolux, Göttingen)
events.summary: Modeci hosts a deep electronic selection night headlined by Metrolux founder XDB, with Ryosuke, Sinqmin, Gong, U YO, Lonho and YOUKU across dance floor and roof.

events.title: SOAR V — Offset Harmonics
events.summary: SOAR’s Cakeshop edition brings E.O.U, DDD, Yetsuby, C Bong Sae, Autopilot77_77 and Human Weak Points for a techno/electronica-focused Seoul showcase.

events.title: INVITES: Antigone
events.summary: Faust’s INVITES series books French techno artist Antigone alongside Kim Bo Yeon, ROS3, duco and TBA across Faust and Tanz Bar.

events.title: Volnost INVITES 'Kohra'
events.summary: Volnost’s INVITES series brings Goa-based Qilla Records founder Kohra to Itaewon for a psychedelic techno/minimal night with Deekay, Siot, KYVU and Seo Youngcha.

events.title: Metacritik : Olsvangèr
events.summary: Metacritik brings Olsvangèr to Atdge Seoul for a high-energy techno/house night with Pseudobaul, Mew and Haemi Park.

events.title: Hertz meets: Onirik (Off The Grid, DE)
events.summary: Hertz hosts Off The Grid’s Onirik for a house-focused all-night session with Baso and Soyo at the Itaewon listening/club space.

events.title: OFFGRID x FRAME presents HENRY FONG
events.summary: OFFGRID and Frame Seoul team for a bass/tech-house club night with Henry Fong, ONVY, Vandal Rock, Guilty Pleasure, PURE100% and TWOC.
